title: きのこの森の図鑑
subject_en: Mushrooms, each ONE separate mushroom or small cluster centred in its cell, storybook watercolor-and-pencil style, with a little moss or leaf at the base; ten edible types and two decorative toadstools Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: しいたけ・まいたけ・ベニテングタケ風の絵など、きのこ12点を絵本のタッチで描いた素材です。秋の資料や食の記事に使えます。
items: two shiitake mushrooms with brown caps
a cluster of shimeji mushrooms with grey-brown caps
a bunch of white enoki mushrooms with thin stems
two matsutake mushrooms with a pine needle
a small group of glossy nameko mushrooms
three round white button mushrooms, one cut in half
a red toadstool with cream-coloured dots on its cap
a decorative blue fantasy toadstool with glowing spots
きのこの生えた切り株
a tree stump covered with small mushrooms
a woven basket full of mixed mushrooms
